description.value: Off The Hook is a lively, casual contemporary seafood restaurant in Nanaimo specializing in fish and chips, smokery dishes, and global-inspired seafood. The entire food menu is 100% gluten-free, making it a notable stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions. The restaurant offers both dine-in with outdoor seating and online ordering for takeout, and accommodates large groups.
